name: greg_allen_shed_p1s_rectangular_scale_1_16
source: Uploaded Greg Allen shed shop drawings
status: corrected rectangular-footprint model based on front/back/side elevations
interpretation_notes: Corrected: the shed is not out of square. The front and back elevations both show the same overall width, so the footprint is rectangular.
The model now uses a single width of 62.25 in for both front and back and a depth of 85.5 in from the side elevations.
The centered front double-door detail is represented as 45 in wide by 45 in high, leaving equal side margins on the 62.25 in front wall.
The model is scaled 1:16 so the full shed fits comfortably inside the Bambu Lab P1S build volume.
Roof overhang, wall thickness, trim projection, battens, and ridge cap are printable representation assumptions unless confirmed by the construction drawing notes.
